gap: No result ChatGPT got states the 3-year cost of owning a feeder with automatic bird ID at today's prices: Birdbuddy Home is $199 + 3 × $98.99 = $495.97 and Nook Solar is $139 + 3 × $98.99 = $435.97, while Birdfy's ID has cost $0 a year on all its feeders since Birdfy's 2 Nov 2026 free-for-life change.
standout_why: Reviewed.com (cited) has no total cost of ownership and still says the Birdfy Feeder 2 Pro needs Birdfy Plus at $79.99/yr after a 7-day trial, which is out of date since 2026-11-02. PlumageDispatch (uncited) gives 36-month totals for the subscription alone: Bird Buddy Family $296.97, and Birdfy Feeder 2 $179.64 on the 'AI by Subscription' version, also out of date now. It lists no hardware prices, so it never adds the feeder price to the plan. I couldn't open WIRED's cited Birdbuddy vs Birdfy piece (fetch blocked). It is dated 2026-11-02, the same day as the Birdfy change, so it may or may not reflect it. No page I opened combines today's maker hardware price with the current plan cost.
decides: This confirms the Birdfy picks on cost. Over 3 years, automatic ID on a Birdbuddy adds $296.97 to the hardware price. A Birdfy feeder could cost up to $495.97 and still match a Birdbuddy Home's 3-year cost. It also means the 'AI by Subscription' vs 'Lifetime AI' choice no longer changes the cost of species ID on Birdfy, so the cheaper SKU wins unless you want sex, age or health flags. Our page should also update the Birdbuddy prices: Home is $199 (not $197.10) and Nook Solar is $139 (not $138.33) as of 2026-11-17.
